goals.notes: BBC: two minutes into stoppage time, Flavio flick-on, volley from edge of the area. Daily News Egypt: long ball relayed by Meteb's head then Flavio's, left-foot finish from outside the area. Wikipedia: 90+2'. Moteab's header is reported only by Daily News Egypt (not contradicted by BBC). · Applied the two-publisher rule: the first header (Moteab) is reported by Daily News Egypt only.

goals.notes: Amwal Al Ghad: Hamdi beat Hichri down the left, reached the byline and pulled back for an unmarked Gedo to side-foot home, two minutes before the break. goals.notes: CAF: eight minutes into the second half, Tawfik Akram pass put Sherif through, lofted over Akpeyi. Goal.com: 53', Akram Tawfik overlapped down the right and played a defence-splitting pass. Reuters (ah-g-reuters-2021) agrees on Tawfik's pass and adds a tight-angle finish; finish type (chip vs angle) not asserted.

goals.notes: CAF: 64', counter after a long ball, Mohamed Taher carried on the left and passed to Afsha, one-two with Sherif, shot to the far left corner. Goal.com: 64', set up by Sherif, curled into the top left corner. Reuters: curling shot from the edge of the box. Height of finish DROPPED (CAF low vs Goal top corner). Taher's two touches and the first leg of the one-two come from CAF only. · Applied the two-publisher rule: the first leg of the one-two is reported by CAF only; Taher Mohamed's pass is reported by CAF only; Taher Mohamed's run is reported by CAF only.

Sources disagree on the preceding touch: Sport24/AFP says Abdallah Said's blocked shot, Al Jazeera says Ahmed Fathi's blocked shot, TimesLIVE says a ball in from Abdalla Mohamed on the right.
Minute disagreement (Sport24 gives both 78' and 79', Al Jazeera about 78', TimesLIVE 79'); assist only named by TimesLIVE ('Mahmoud').
